title: There is no elementary embedding of a larger free system into a smaller one
author: Silvia Barbina; Enrique Casanovas
work: The elementary theory of free Steiner triple systems
difficulty_reason: Counted unit is the author's labelled proposition at source lines 1089-1090: for n at least three and m larger than n there is no elementary embedding of the free system on m generators into the free system on n generators, even though the latter embeds into the former. The proof (source lines 1091-1094) builds the contradiction by taking a copy of the larger free system extending the smaller one so that the inclusion is elementary, which converts the assumed embedding into an elementary embedding of the larger system into itself with a proper image; that is precisely what the preceding surjectivity proposition forbids. The statement records the non-existence and neither the construction of the elementary extension nor the reduction to the self-embedding case.
